title: Ultra-realistic low-light fashion portra
prompt:
Ultra-realistic low-light fashion portrait of a young adult woman standing against a plain textured gray concrete wall, photographed with direct point-and-shoot flash. The image has a raw, intimate, late-night editorial mood with a slightly grainy early-2000s digital-camera aesthetic.

She has extremely long, straight dark chocolate-brown hair falling past her waist, glossy but natural, with full blunt bangs skimming just above her eyes. A few fine strands fall loosely across her chest. Soft feminine makeup with subtle brown eyeshadow, long lashes, gently flushed cheeks, luminous skin, and glossy nude-pink lips. Her expression is quiet and slightly distant, eyes looking downward and off to one side rather than directly at the camera.

Outfit: a burnt rust-orange draped mini dress made from lightweight, slightly sheer jersey or fine knit fabric. The dress has long fitted sleeves extending slightly over the wrists and hands, with a dramatically plunging open front and loose cascading fabric gathered around the lower torso and hips. The silhouette is fluid, asymmetrical, and softly wrapped rather than structured, with long hanging fabric panels creating movement along the sides. Warm terracotta, cinnamon, and burnt-orange tones.

She wears sheer dark stockings underneath, with a subtle lace or patterned detail visible near the upper thigh. Minimal accessories, keeping the styling understated and sensual.

Pose: standing close to the wall with her body angled slightly away from the camera, one hip shifted outward. One arm hangs naturally at her side while the other hand gently gathers or holds part of the draped fabric near her waist. Shoulders relaxed, chin slightly lowered, creating an introspective, unposed expression.

Background: completely minimal industrial interior with a cool gray plaster or concrete wall, faint surface imperfections and subtle stains. A small fragment of dark metal furniture or railing enters the lower edge of the frame, adding to the imperfect candid composition. No decorative objects or luxury setting.

Photography: harsh direct camera flash against an otherwise dim room, strong flash falloff, soft shadow behind the subject, muted colors, slight underexposure around the edges, visible fine grain and digital noise, realistic skin texture, slight softness, compact-camera snapshot quality, minimal retouching, authentic 2000s fashion-blog photography, underground editorial mood, photorealistic.

Composition: vertical full or three-quarter body portrait, subject placed slightly off-center, generous empty gray wall around her, close handheld framing, slightly imperfect crop, 3:4 aspect ratio.

Negative prompt: bright studio lighting, luxury hotel, elaborate background, heavy jewelry, voluminous hairstyle, curls, high-fashion runway pose, exaggerated body proportions, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, extreme HDR, neon lighting, oversaturated orange, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, distorted clothing, cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI.
